title: verify family split (#15953), engine rows: objectql and driver-sql regression tests that replace hotcrm's platform-semantics pins (rows 3, 4-5, 7, 8, 10, 11)
body:
Filing gate **④ a split of a routed card by landing lane**: triage split objectstack-ai/objectstack#15953 (retriage `6183290473`) under the lane rule 「按落点判归属」. Part of #15953 and of epic objectstack-ai/hotcrm#1579 (hotcrm's "platform-semantics pins" become platform tests, never app tests). Filed by the triage seat (seat post #6015, `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`). ⛔ Not a claim.

`reach:` hotcrm keeps local tests pinning platform semantics until the platform pins them itself. Each row below names the hotcrm file it replaces. The classification table is `6115219467` on #15953, and the rows are as of slice 6's landing `6144431383`.

## Rows (the R residues that land in `domain:engine`)

| row | hotcrm file | platform test to add |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 3 | `test/line-item-cascade.test.ts` | `packages/objectql` referential-pass test: a spec-default `set_null` on a REQUIRED lookup escalates to restrict |
| 4-5 | `test/lead-duplicate-link-cleanup.test.ts`, `test/freeze-guard-reference-cleanup.test.ts` | `packages/objectql` referential-pass tests for the reference-cleanup write the two files lean on (their K halves stay in hotcrm) |
| 7 | `test/case-number-tenant-scope.test.ts` | `packages/drivers/driver-sql` test: the old table-composite unique constrained nothing untenanted (SQL NULL-distinct, ADR-0120 D3) |
| 8 | `test/readonly-write-semantics.test.ts` | `packages/objectql` update-path test: a read-only field is stripped iff the context is not system |
| 10 | `test/undeclared-key-probe.test.ts` | `packages/objectql` write-path test: an undeclared key on the caller path answers `INVALID_FIELD` / 400 (the dogfood driver conformance half stays on #15953) |
| 11 | `test/flow-filter-today-token.test.ts` | `packages/objectql` `resolveFilterTokens` test: the query layer refuses the `TODAY()` spelling and knows `{today}` (the service-automation half is its own card) |

## What done looks like

- Each row lands as a platform test in its package, pinning the semantics the hotcrm file pins, with one ablation each.
- Each row's landing names the hotcrm file it lets hotcrm retire (objectstack-ai/hotcrm#1583).
- Rows may land in more than one PR, each `Part of` this card. The card closes when all rows are carried.

**Grade:** p3, as #15953. **Lane:** `domain:engine` (`packages/objectql`, `packages/drivers/driver-sql`).
